## Highlights
- **🕒 Time in the Assignment Details popup.** "Last Updated: 11/23/26" now shows the time too, like "Last Updated: 11/23/26, 7:55 AM". It works wherever the popup opens: class pages, To Do, Overview and Calendar.
- **🕒 Time in Recently Updated Grades.** The Overview page's **Recently Updated Grades** box now shows when each grade came in, like "today 7:55 AM", instead of just "today".

## Changes
- Alma's popup only shows the date, so Alma+ reads the exact time from the class page's Updated column (right away on a class page, or with one quick read of that class page elsewhere).
- Also from today: the time under the date in the class page's **Updated** column (2.15.3), updated time and grade in **New & Updated Assignments** (2.15.1), and **New grade alerts** (2.15).

## How to update
1. Download the zip below and unzip it.
2. Copy its files over your old Alma+ folder (same place, same folder name).
3. Go to `chrome://extensions` and click reload ↻ on Alma+, then refresh Alma.
4. Open a graded assignment and look at **Last Updated**.

> ⚠️ Don't remove the extension to update — removing it deletes your saved tasks. Back up your tasks first with **Back up tasks** on the To Do page if you're unsure.
